title: Restriction of scalars detects vanishing of higher direct images
statement: Let $R,S$ be commutative rings in the same coefficient universe and $\varphi:R\to S$ a ring homomorphism. Let $h:Y\to X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], and $F$ a sheaf of $S$-modules on the small etale site of $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For every integer $q$, the higher direct image of $F$ vanishes if and only if the higher direct image of its restriction to $R$-modules vanishes [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Restriction of scalars is defined objectwise by $r\cdot x=\varphi(r)x$; it does not change the underlying additive groups.

proof.text: Apply restrictScalars_baseChange_comparison to the Cartesian square with horizontal maps identities and both vertical maps h. This compares the targets in coefficients R and S.
The already-proved baseChangeTargetFunctorIso and upperStarId identify each target with higherDirectImage along h; map these isomorphisms through restriction of scalars and compose.

Restriction of scalars preserves zero morphisms and is faithful. An object is zero exactly when its identity map is zero, so restriction of scalars preserves and reflects zero objects. Transport this equivalence through the comparison isomorphism.

theorem isZero_higherDirectImage_restrictScalars_iff
    {R S : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ X) [QuasiCompact h] [QuasiSeparated h]
    (q : ℤ) (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S)) :
    IsZero (higherDirectImage R h q ((Sheaf.restrictScalars Y.smallEtaleTopology φ).obj F)) ↔
      IsZero (higherDirectImage S h q F)
